report.evidenceKind: Ordinary targeted PE static inspection and supplied Pascal/ERM source reads. Not REA native Evidence. No dynamic validation or game execution.

contract.sourceLevelConvention: zero-based: ordinary0..6 correspond to creature levels1..7; -1 is accepted as unavailable/no subgroup. MON_MAX_LEVEL=6 in ERA constants.
contract.getter: ZvsApply reads signed int32 field; its nonzero GET result skips both clamp and modification marker. No read-time normalization or +1 conversion.
contract.setter: Plain SET or relative modifier writes through common PutVal first, then signed clamp[-1,6], then modification marker7504d6.
contract.relativeArithmetic: Common PutVal operates in int32; addition, subtraction and low32-bit multiplication wrap before MA:L signed clamping. No overflow rejection or saturation before the clamp.
contract.rounding: The level branch and Add/Sub/Mul paths are integer-only. There is no floating-point rounding in MA:L. Generic signed integer division uses truncation toward zero. Coercion of a floating argument by the command parser is not established here.
contract.creatureIdGuard: On-disk handler accepts0<=id<197; actual expanded-roster relocation/patches are a separate boundary.

regions.name: Receiver MA table entry
regions.observation: Packed ID0x414d identifies MA; handler pointer7563c3 and config0.

regions.name: MA parameter and creature guard
regions.observation: Require at least2 parameters; creature ID0..196 on disk, then dispatch subcommand by jump table.

regions.name: MA:L get/set and signed clamp
regions.observation: Pass MonInfoBase+0x74*id+4 with size4 and parameter1 to ZvsApply74195d. Nonzero return skips mutation. On SET, signed lower bound-1 and upper bound6 are enforced, then7504d6(id) called.

regions.name: ZvsApply hook set/get
regions.observation: SET calls PutVal494290 synchronously; GET reads source value and writes destination ERM parameter, returning nonzero. Shared hook already identified and installed in prior option149 proof.

regions.name: PutVal Add/Sub/Mul
regions.observation: 32-bit ADD, SUB, IMUL, no overflow checks between operation and common final-store path.

regions.name: PutVal final32 store
regions.observation: For size4, store the computed32-bit value to the supplied pointer. No level-specific clamp in this common helper.

regions.name: MA modification marker
regions.observation: Validates ID, calls7103d2(current day), stores returned integer in per-creature table8a3210[id]. This function does not recompute bonuses, native tier, recruitment, or existing stacks.

regions.name: Current-day helper
regions.observation: Reads GameDate at840ce0 and calculates absolute day from day/week/month; Erm.pas785 names it ZvsGetCurrDay.

regions.name: Modified-descriptor copy excerpt
regions.observation: A separate marker-conditioned path copies the level field into a modified-creature record at2773870. Full lifecycle/serialization semantics not established here.

regions.name: Native level consumer excerpt
regions.observation: Reads MonInfo+4 via runtime base6747b0 and passes it to4e6260. Exact downstream gameplay admission not asserted.

regions.name: Native level6 comparison
regions.observation: Native code compares this same field to6. This confirms a shared descriptor field rather than a separate ERM-only attribute.

sourceCrossChecks.boundedHookSearch: No explicit MA:L receiver replacement or patch at7563/7564/7565/7569/7504d6 was found in supplied kernel Pascal. Generic ZvsApply is hooked. Third-party plugins and automatic extended-roster relocation are not excluded.

boundedConsumers.effects: Eligibility compares current source MA:L of base/upgraded creature for equality. Basic mithril dwelling cost uses upgraded source level:<=3 costs1,4..5 costs2,>5 costs3. A new MA:L value can therefore affect both eligibility and price without changing any creature stats or native town tier.

boundedConsumers.source: 245 wog - creatures level 7th only gain half experience.erm
boundedConsumers.effects: Reads MA:L and applies the level7+ experience rule when source level>=MON_MAX_LEVEL(6). This is another explicit ERM consumer, not part of a limited mithril-only admission.
Pendant of Life script reads MA:L to choose a derived HP expression. Not automatically admitted by supporting mithril reads.
The shared descriptor has native readers and separate modified-descriptor copying. Their existence is observed, but a full list, refresh timing and complete gameplay consequences are not established.

derivedExamples.kind: Static arithmetic deductions, not executed observations
derivedExamples.criticalCase: MA:L0/d2147483647 with previous L0=6: modulo32 sum0x80000005=-2147483643, then signed clamp to-1.
derivedExamples.getterBoundary: A pre-existing field value7 would be read as7 by GET; SET7 would store6 in the observed on-disk branch. Do not clamp raw reads to6.

limits: No game, Wine or container execution. No source files or build container were modified.
Exact original game/ERA identities are recorded, but arbitrary mod/plugin runtime patches and expanded-roster address relocation are not dynamically validated.
The signed[-1,6] setter clamp is an observed on-disk MA:L branch; GET bypasses it. Initial data or other direct writes can expose values outside that range.
The per-creature day marker is observed; complete persistence, synchronization and refresh of existing stacks were not traced.

Consumers were intentionally bounded to mithril and a few source/native witnesses. No general admission of native bonuses, town tiers, HP rules or experience systems follows from adding mithril MA:L support.
No original executable bytes or disassembly text appear in this report.
